settings.mission_paragraph_1: Purelane is a plant-powered home cleaning brand founded on the belief that everyday cleaning products should be safe, effective, and free from toxic compromises. We engineer thoughtful cleaning solutions that deliver cleaner, fresher, and healthier living spaces for families across India.
settings.mission_paragraph_2: From tackling tough kitchen grease and bathroom limescale to gentle laundry care, our plant-derived formulas replace harsh fumes and synthetic irritants with hardworking bio-enzymes and natural botanical extracts. It is practical everyday cleaning made safer for your home, your loved ones, and the environment.
